elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 28.1 expressly provides that the Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York.

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
elements.evidence: Section 28.2 expressly grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts located in New York County; the narrow temporary-injunctive-relief carveout does not change the forum for the merits.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects New York law, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales law.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects courts in New York County, not Delaware or California courts or the courts of London.
